title: Minting and burning of `BeamToken` is centralized
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as token supply can be endlessly inflated and user tokens can be burned on demand  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a malicious or compromised admin/minter/burner  ## Description  Currently the `mint` and `burn` methods in `BeamToken` are controlled by `MINTER_ROLE` and `BURNER_ROLE` respectively. Those roles are controlled by the `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` which is given to the `BeamToken` deployer.
